sentences.japanese: パーティーで彼女に会えるように取り計らいます。
sentences.english: I will see to it that you meet her at the party.

sentences.japanese: 苦情は出来るだけ迅速に処理されるよう取り計らいなさい。
sentences.english: Make sure that the complaints are dealt with as quickly as possible.

sentences.japanese: 金銭は成功を計る基準にはならない。
sentences.english: Money is not a criterion of success.

sentences.japanese: 看護婦は体温計で彼の体温を計った。
sentences.english: The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer.
